Fender
Studio Pro X

A free community expansion that gives you your own version of Fender Studio Pro 8.2.

FreeYour licensed copyLicensing untouchedOne-click uninstallVersion 2.0.0
Get it free on GitHub github.com/ferrerokush-png/fender-studio-pro-x

What it is

Twelve packages that sit on top of the Studio Pro you already own.

Free, for everyone

No price, no account, no sign-up. Our own code, open under the MIT licence.

Your own licensed copy

It installs on your Studio Pro 8.2 (build 8.2.0.114903). No sign-in, licence or program code of Fender’s is shipped.

Licensing is never touched

Sign-in, activation, subscriptions and the store work exactly as before. Nothing here goes near them.

One-click uninstall

Hold Shift at start for stock, or run Uninstall and you are back to plain Studio Pro. Or remove just one package.

Heads up

I’m a producer, not a programmer. I build these mods with AI coding tools and test each release on my own setup, on one Studio Pro build (8.2.0.114903). They change how Studio Pro looks and works, so things can still break, especially after a Studio Pro update. Back up your songs first, use it at your own risk, and if anything acts up, run the uninstaller to go back to stock.

Fender Studio Pro X02

Version 2.0.0

What is new in 2.0.0.

  • Chords panel. See and swap chords in the piano roll, with ideas that fit your key and ghost notes before you commit.
  • Expression mode for pitch curves. Draw, edit and shape a pitch line for each note.
  • Sound search, upgraded. Find similar sounds, tags, saved searches, watched folders, paste at the playhead.
  • Appearance window. Ready-made themes: Liquid Glass (seven accents) and Original.
  • Skin options. Faders, M/S/R, meters and the transport bar (Console, Island, Classic), each with a picture.
  • Chat assistant. Talk to your song with your own Claude Code subscription. Off at first.
  • Small extras. Free-Hz arpeggiator rate, and a fix for some docked plug-in windows.
  • For Studio Pro 8.2.0.114903. On another build the pack starts Studio Pro stock-looking and safe, and says what it turned off. 1.4.1 stays for 8.1.2.

Plug-in browser

Sound Search

Search your own sample folders by name, key, tempo and type. Preview in time and in key with the song (MIDI files too, on the selected track), then drag it onto a track. Play with song starts and stops loops and MIDI files with Studio Pro’s Play and Stop.

New in 2.0.0 · Chords panel

Chords that help you write.

  • See the chord under the playhead, or the notes you picked, and swap it for ideas that fit your key.
  • Build into empty bars, hear a click through your own instrument, and see ghost notes in the piano roll before you commit.
  • Choose how it plays: your own timing, a strum or an arpeggio.

Package 11. Needs Pitch curves and the AI tools bridge (added for you). Chord statistics come from the Chordonomicon dataset, CC BY-NC 4.0: free use only.

Fender Studio Pro XPackage 11 · Chords panel    09

New in 2.0.0 · Chords panel

Swap a chord, or build from nothing.

  • Chord page. The chord under the playhead, with swaps that fit your key and ideas with the same feel.
  • Build page. Pick a chord for an empty bar from ideas that fit and what often comes next. Click to hear it, drag it onto the grid.
  • Choose how it plays: held, or like the bar before, with your own timing, a strum or an arpeggio.

Package 11. Panel pictures use a demo song.

Updated in 2.0.0 · Pitch curves

Draw pitch like automation.

  • Expression mode: draw, edit and shape a pitch line for each note, right in the piano roll.
  • Labels use note names, like E3 +30c. A point you drag to a key row sounds that note.
  • Right-click a line for Straight, Ease in, Ease out or S-curve. One Undo per gesture.

Package 09. Made for Studio Pro 8.2.0.114903.

Fender Studio Pro XPackage 09 · Pitch curves    11

Updated in 2.0.0 · Sound search

Find sounds by how they sound.

  • Find similar sounds, or search in plain words. A small sound model does the listening on your own PC. Get it once: download FSPX-sound-model.zip (about 190 MB) from the release page, unzip it anywhere and double click Install-Sound-Model.bat. Everything else in Sound search works without it.
  • Tags, saved searches, watched folders, and paste at the playhead. Folder layouts for the details.
  • Works on your graphics card or your processor. No Python needed.

Package 06. The first listening pass runs only when your PC is idle. Your sound index lives on your PC and grows with your library.

Fender Studio Pro XPackage 06 · Sound search    12

Updated in 2.0.0 · AI tools

A chat assistant that knows your song.

  • Talk to your song with your own Claude Code subscription. Install Claude Code and sign in yourself. No keys are stored or shipped.
  • It can read and change tracks, mixing, sends, plug-in settings, MIDI and automation, through the same buttons you use. Every edit can be undone.
  • Off at first. It spends your own Claude plan limits, and the mixing tools need Python 3.12 or newer.

Package 10. Studio Pro never sends anything until you start a chat turn.

Fender Studio Pro XPackage 10 · AI tools    13

Two small fixes that matter.

  • A fix that makes some docked plug-in windows show up, for example Vovious.
  • Both are tuned to Studio Pro 8.2.0.114903 and stay quietly off on other builds.

Fender Studio Pro X15

Install in three steps.

1

Close and unzip

Close Studio Pro. Unzip the pack anywhere. Each package has its own folder and a short README.

2

Run Install

Double-click Install.bat and tick the packages you want, with switches under each. It adds what a package needs and shows a summary before it changes anything.

3

Start and pick

Start Studio Pro, open the Appearance window and pick a theme. Themes are ready-made, so there is nothing to build.

The installer lists what it will add before it changes anything (demo folder, dry run).

Needs Windows 10 or 11 and your own licensed Studio Pro 8.2 (build 8.2.0.114903); on 8.1.2 use pack 1.4.1. Python 3.11 or newer is only for the look options, and Python 3.12 or newer for the chat’s mixing tools. The chat needs Claude Code, signed in by you. It asks for administrator rights once, for the loader file. Upgrading from 1.4.1: run Install.bat again, your settings are kept.

Fender Studio Pro X16

Back to stock, any time.

Shift

For one start

Hold Shift while Studio Pro starts. You get the stock look for that start.

Uninstall.bat

Remove everything

Run the top-level one and Studio Pro is exactly stock again. Any file a package replaced comes back from the copy kept at install.

packages\NN-name\Uninstall.bat

Remove one package

Each package has its own. Packages that need it go too, and it tells you before it does anything.

Install.bat again

Change a switch

Run Install.bat again and untick the switch or the package. The summary shows what will be removed.

Your settings and songs are never moved. Saved views, favourites and folders are kept.

Fender Studio Pro X17

Our promise

Respect for the program, and for the people who make it.

  • Licensing stays untouched. No changes to sign-in, activation, subscriptions or the store. Ever.
  • No sign-in or licence parts, no program code. Nothing that signs you in, activates or licenses Studio Pro is included, and none of Fender’s program code is shipped.
  • No surprises online. Only news, the artist card, YouTube, the optional better stems download and the chat (your own Claude Code) go online, and each has an off switch or asks first.
  • Every change can be undone. Where a package replaces a stock file (for example the Track List and the Plug-in browser), the original is kept and Uninstall puts it back.
  • Open and free. Our code is MIT licensed. Third-party models and tools keep their own licences.
  • Your projects come first. Settings and songs stay where they are. Back up as usual.
